notes.title: Mac Version Released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It has taken a little longer than I hoped, but Crime Reaper is now available for Mac OS! If you already own a copy of Crime Reaper, you should immediately have access to play the Mac version.

Due to some constraints on my end, I do not have as thorough testing as the Windows version, so please feel free to comment with any issues you may have when playing the Mac version.

notes.title: Update Notes - Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
A special thank you to everyone who has picked up [i]Crime Reaper[/i] and left comments over the last two months! I'm so humbled that there are so many of you that seem so excited and have enjoyed playing it! I've taken some time to add some highly requested features and fixed issues that have been reported. Again, thank you so much for playing!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added toggle for turning on/off playboard highlights to allow the game to be more difficult for proficient players
[*] Added Restart button that can be used while paused during a puzzle
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixed bug where tokens could become frozen on the board when trying to select another token
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] fixed issue where international players in locales that use comma notation for decimal numbers caused their progress not to load properly when reopening the game
[*] Mx. Death now hops away when they are done talking to you
[/list]
